# Lanka Data

> Sri Lankan census and election data. Infer available datasets from the live metadata used by the app, then fetch relevant upstream files. No login or API key.

## Entry points

- [Discovery guide](https://nuuuwan.github.io/lanka_data/data/index.html): readable instructions and links to the app's live metadata indexes, without JavaScript.
- [Source registry](https://nuuuwan.github.io/lanka_data/sources.json): metadataURL and baseURL for each data source, from the same configuration used by the app. Contains no cached metadata or observations.
- [API guide](https://nuuuwan.github.io/lanka_data/api.md): metadata interpretation, nested JSON format, query syntax, geographic identifiers, units, citations and working Python retrieval.

## Live metadata used by the app

- [Census2024 metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuuuwan/lk_census_2024/refs/heads/main/metadata/lanka_data.metadata.json): base URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuuuwan/lk_census_2024/refs/heads/main
- [GIG metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuuuwan/gig-data/refs/heads/master/lanka_data/metadata.json): base URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuuuwan/gig-data/refs/heads/master

## Retrieval procedure

1. Identify subject, year, geography and breakdown. Fetch the live metadata indexes; do not infer availability from gallery examples or a fixed query list.
2. Metadata maps keys such as House/Time+District+CookingFuel/Count to relative file paths. Match entity, dimension-name set and aggregate. Dimension order can vary. A key establishes a dimension combination, not every possible year, region or category value.
3. Form each relevant file URL by joining the source's baseURL, a slash, and the exact metadata path. Fetch and inspect the files to confirm the requested values. Avoid downloading unrelated files.
4. Source files contain nested objects: entity → dimension:value → … → aggregate → typed value (for example Int:123). They do not have a datumList field. Filter to the requested coordinates, including a single geographic level, before calculating.
5. Preserve scalar types and units. Missing rows are not evidence of zero. Check totals and duplicates before summing, and do not combine separate tables into unsupported cross-tabulations.
6. State the observation year, unit and geography. Cite the exact upstream data URL and the official source: Department of Census and Statistics (https://www.statistics.gov.lk) for census data, Elections Commission (https://elections.gov.lk) for Vote data. Identify the intermediary repository and any calculations.
7. If the metadata lacks the requested combination or retrieval fails, explain what is unavailable; do not substitute another year or region silently.

## Hosting

The build does not fetch metadata, download raw data, execute queries, or generate data snapshots. GitHub Pages serves the app and discovery instructions, not a query API. Browser JSON downloads are created from client-fetched data. Local /JSON/raw.json endpoints execute supported queries on demand.

A ChatGPT session needs web access or an HTTP-capable tool to retrieve live metadata and data.
